subject: Demo hold: procurement/security checklist required before live walkthrough
messages:
From: Sarah Bennett <sarah.bennett@stratushealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@stratushealth.com
Date: 2026-03-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request to schedule product walkthrough — procurement gating items

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the initial discovery call yesterday. The Stratus evaluation team is excited to see a live walkthrough of Redwood’s inference platform. Before we lock a date for a demo, our procurement and security teams require a quick intake to be completed:

- Attached vendor security questionnaire (primary) — we need answers + attachments for any attestations.
- Executed NDA or mutual confidentiality agreement.
- Copy of SOC 2 Type II report OR auditor letter (if available).

I’m attaching our standard questionnaire (Stratus-Vendor-Questionnaire-2026.pdf). Procurement can typically turn around review within 2–3 business days once we have the completed questionnaire + NDA. For scheduling purposes, please consider the demo tentative until these items are done.

Can you confirm a single point of contact on your side who will fill the questionnaire? Also let me know whether your SOC 2 is shareable or if we should accept an auditor attestation instead.

Best,
Sarah Bennett
Senior Procurement Manager, Stratus Health
procurement@stratushealth.com

Attachment: Stratus-Vendor-Questionnaire-2026.pdf

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Bennett <sarah.bennett@stratushealth.com>
Cc: procurement@stratushealth.com
Date: 2026-03-25T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to schedule product walkthrough — procurement gating items

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clarity and for attaching the questionnaire.

We’ll pause firm scheduling on the public demo until procurement signs off — makes sense to keep the 30-minute slot tentative. I’m looping in our SE and AM so we can get the questionnaire completed quickly and gather the requested artifacts. Quick answers to your questions:

- Point of contact: Priyom Das (Sales Engineer) will own the questionnaire and gather attachments.
- NDA: we can sign a mutual NDA — happy to route via DocuSign (please share your template if you prefer).
- SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II attestation; we can provide either the report under an NDA or an auditor attestation letter.

I’ll attach our short security one-pager that summarizes controls and what we can share immediately. Priyom, can you take the questionnaire and aim to return it by end of day 3/26? Stephanie — can you hold a tentative demo slot on 2026-03-30 in case procurement clears?

Mina Haddad
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai

Attachment: Redwood-Security-OnePager-2026.pdf

From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@stratushealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Sarah Bennett <sarah.bennett@stratushealth.com>
Cc: procurement@stratushealth.com, legal@stratushealth.com
Date: 2026-03-25T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to schedule product walkthrough — procurement gating items

Mina / Sarah — quick procurement/legal callback:

Thanks for the prompt reply. A couple of clarifications from our side:

1) NDA: We prefer to send our standard mutual NDA for signature. If Redwood prefers, we can accept your DocuSign link but would need to review first.
2) SOC 2: If you can’t share the full report, an auditor attestation letter is acceptable for initial screening.
3) Additional ask: we require an inventory of subprocessors and a short answer on data retention & deletion policies for model inputs (we can use a short form).

If Priyom can provide the completed questionnaire and a subprocessors list by 3/26 EOD, procurement will attempt to review by 3/30. If we are delayed, we’ll push the demo until the week of 4/5.

Tom Alvarez
Director, Vendor Management — Stratus Health
Tom.Alvarez@stratushealth.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Bennett <sarah.bennett@stratushealth.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@stratushealth.com>, procurement@stratushealth.com
Date: 2026-03-26T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Action: questionnaire + subprocessors list + tentative demo hold

Priyom / Stephanie — following up with the plan below so we have a single source of truth: 

- Priyom: owner for completing the attached Stratus questionnaire and adding the subprocessors inventory. Please deliver the completed PDF + any supporting attestations (SOC 2 attestation or auditor letter) by EOD 2026-03-26. If you need any artifacts from infra/security, I can escalate.
- Stephanie: please hold a tentative 45-minute demo window on 2026-03-30 10:00–10:45 PT and block the week of 4/5 with 3 alternate windows (AM, midday, PM) so Sarah has options if procurement pushes.
- Mina: I’ll offer to provide a redacted infra diagram if procurement wants to see architecture and hosting boundaries.

Priyom — quick confirmation is fine. I’ve pasted Tom’s asks below for convenience.

> On Wed, Mar 25, 2026 at 2:45 PM Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@stratushealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the prompt reply. A couple of clarifications from our side:
> 1) NDA: We prefer to send our standard mutual NDA for signature.
> 2) SOC 2: Auditor attestation acceptable.
> 3) Additional ask: inventory of subprocessors + short data retention answers.

Thanks —
Mina

--

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>

To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>

Sounds good — I’ll own the questionnaire and aim to return the completed PDF by EOD 3/26. I have the subprocessors inventory; will pull the latest SOC 2 attestation (should be sharable under NDA). Date: 2026-03-28T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to schedule product walkthrough — procurement gating items

Mina / team — quick update from procurement: we had a couple of reviewers out on travel this week, so the intake review will slip a few days. Realistically the earliest we can commit to a live demo is the week of April 5 (3 options: Tue 4/6 AM, Wed 4/7 midday, Thu 4/8 PM PST).

We received your one-pager and the partially completed questionnaire; thank you — that helped. Tom expects to have the final confirmation by 4/1. Can you confirm your availability for one of the above slots (Priyom / Stephanie)? Also please send any NDA link you prefer and we’ll circulate our template if needed.

Thanks — appreciate the responsiveness.

Sarah
Senior Procurement Manager, Stratus Health
